items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well I was with Buddy Rich first with Earl and then I was there with Rob. We also became very close.

ctx.x: And… yeah, they were good partiers, and Rob was a good trombone player.
Yeah, Gerry Mulligan talks about having both of the Swope brothers on Elliot Lawrence’s band and…
